name: Public visitor becomes verified applicant
gaps: No admissions capability or applicant verification flow exists.

name: Applicant becomes student without duplicate identity
gaps: Applicant-to-student identity linking is a design document, not a tested workflow.

name: Student signs in through institution SSO
gaps: SSO policy is proved in SQL; no browser journey exercises a real identity provider.

name: Student uploads a course packet and receives source-linked outputs
gaps: Persistence and derivation receipts are proved in SQL; no end-to-end upload journey runs in CI.

name: Student corrects an extracted date; calendar and study assets regenerate
gaps: Correction bindings exist in SQL; regeneration of calendar and study assets is not an end-to-end test.

name: Student asks a grounded question and sees citations and AI disclosure
gaps: Policy and audit are proved in SQL; the citation and disclosure rendering has no browser journey.

name: Student checks registration readiness and receives a non-enrollment receipt
gaps: No HTTP route or worker calls the readiness store yet (capabilities/registration.readiness.json api stage is false).

name: Registrar sees only authorized case data, reviews blocker, and routes it
gaps: The registrar readiness case screen is a contract (screen_contracts) without an implementation.

name: Faculty grades a submission; draft cannot appear as official grade
gaps: Draft and official stores are separate in SQL; no journey proves the boundary across the gradebook screen.

name: Official grade reference syncs and displays source and freshness
gaps: No SIS adapter is connected; grade freshness display has no live source.

name: Advisor creates a referral under appropriate consent and scope
gaps: Referral SQL is proved; no advising screen or browser journey exists.

name: Student grants, narrows, and revokes family access
gaps: Grant and revoke are proved in SQL; narrowing a live delegation is not an end-to-end test.

name: Student initiates payment; signed provider webhook reconciles exactly once
gaps: The payment inbox is exactly-once in SQL; no student payment intent reaches a provider (D13).

name: Employer posts opportunity; student applies with explicit record-sharing consent
gaps: No employer portal exists.

name: Community member reports a post; moderator resolves and appeal works
gaps: Moderation audit is proved in SQL; the appeal path has no test.

name: Marketplace listing creates offer, payment state, dispute, and refund workflow
gaps: Offers, disputes and refunds have no code (D35 not started).

name: Institution admin creates grant; revocation blocks session, API, and queued job
gaps: Grant revocation is proved in SQL and the queue refuses a wrong-tenant event; a single journey across session, API and worker does not exist.

name: Developer creates sandbox app, key, webhook, and handles a signed delivery
gaps: No developer app registration model exists.

name: Company implementation team activates a new tenant and completes integration checklist
gaps: Tenant rollout state is proved in SQL; the implementation checklist is a document.

name: Operations operator resolves an incident and produces postmortem evidence
gaps: Incident rows are proved in SQL; postmortem evidence capture is a runbook step, not a tested command.

name: Privacy officer processes an export or deletion request
gaps: Export and deletion are proved in SQL and the account-sync CI job deletes a real account; the privacy-officer workflow has no screen.

name: Release rollback restores prior application version without data corruption
gaps: Rollback is a documented procedure; no drill artifact is produced automatically.

name: Backup restore produces a usable isolated recovery environment
gaps: The restore drill script exists; no scheduled run writes a drill artifact into a release pack.

name: Cross-tenant read/write attempt fails through UI, API, SQL/RLS, worker, search, and AI retrieval
gaps: SQL/RLS, the policy engine and the queue are guarded; UI, search and AI retrieval have no cross-tenant test.
